test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). T is fourth to the right of W and second to the right of Q. V is fourth to the left of P. P is not the neighbour of W. Only two persons sit between P and R.

If Q is not the neighbour of S, then who is to the immediate right of W?
solution:
**Given:** P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

1) T is fourth to the right of W and second to the right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3d50f221051e4d1bffc0181ad1501135e6948ff6cfcad13c398ad89c76f06d.png] 

2) V is fourth to the left of P.

3) P is not the neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/329156296b5fe2b2efc1c180968c6d0465057478d51d4077fb1675279305aa66.png] 

4) Only two persons sit between P and R.

5) Q is not the neighbour of S.

After positioning R and S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a3a1e14591100a7b99e8d862336adb85106c645db4610dce28bb22a1a7b56c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, U is to the immediate right of W.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
